Lead Abatement Requirement Notification

SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED WITHIN 100 FEET OF A CHILD-OCCUPIED FACILITY.

NO DEMO TO BE COMPLETED WITHOUT ISSUED DOEE LEAD ABATEMENT PERMIT. DO NOT PULL POSTCARD PERMIT.

ENGAGING IN DEMOLITION WITHOUT A PERMIT IS CONTRARY TO LOCAL AND FEDERAL LAW, REGARLDESS OF THE ISSUANCE OF A DOB POSTCARD PERMIT

Based on the information provided, this work proposed under this permit application will require a DOEE lead abatement permit.

The requirement to obtain a lead permit is based on property being located within 100 feet of a child occupied facility, and the legal presumption that all painted components in dwellings constructed prior to 1978 are coated in lead-based paint, and the demolition of components covered with such paint.

For a list of DC certified-lead-based paint abatement companies who can apply for the permit, please go to https://doee.dc.gov/node/55572.  For more information about getting certified as a DC-certified business entity approved to conduct lead abatement projects, contact [EMAIL] or apply online https://doee.dc.gov/publication/professional-certification-lead-based-paint-activities.

Applicant must upload issued DOEE permit prior to EV review approval. If you believe the components to be disturbed are not coated in lead-based paint, email [EMAIL] for guidance.
